MobEntity.Name: Hellhound
MobEntity.Description: A snarling demonic hound with scorched fur and ember-red eyes. The weakest of the canine pack, but no less dangerous in numbers.

MobEntity.Name: Demon Wolf
MobEntity.Description: A larger and more cunning hellhound, moving in coordinated packs. Its bite can shatter bone armour.

MobEntity.Name: Cerberus
MobEntity.Description: The three-headed guardian of Hell's gates. Each head acts independently, making it nearly impossible to anticipate its attacks.

MobEntity.Name: Zombie Pvt
MobEntity.Description: A reanimated private, shambling forward with a rifle. Slow and predictable, but still armed and dangerous.

MobEntity.Name: Zombie Lt
MobEntity.Description: A reanimated lieutenant with better weaponry and slightly more resilience. Commands squads of zombie privates.

MobEntity.Name: Zombie Cpt
MobEntity.Description: A reanimated captain carrying heavy ordnance. Significantly more durable and hits far harder than its lower-ranked kin.

MobEntity.Name: Impling
MobEntity.Description: A juvenile imp, small and weak but quick to swarm. Often found in large groups preceding a larger demonic force.

MobEntity.Name: Imp Troop
MobEntity.Description: The standard front-line imp. Hurls flaming bolts from a distance and slashes viciously in close quarters.

MobEntity.Name: Imp Commando
MobEntity.Description: A heavily built imp clad in crude hellforged plating. Hits harder and takes more punishment than a standard troop.

MobEntity.Name: Imp Assassin
MobEntity.Description: A lean, shadow-cloaked imp that teleports behind its prey. Less durable than a commando but far more lethal per strike.

MobEntity.Name: Phantom
MobEntity.Description: A semi-transparent imp that phases in and out of corporeality, making it difficult to hit with physical attacks.

MobEntity.Name: Imp Lord
MobEntity.Description: The apex of impkind. Commands lesser imps and unleashes torrents of hellfire. A serious threat to any marine.

MobEntity.Name: Lost Soul
MobEntity.Description: A flaming demonic skull that hurls itself at prey in a relentless charge. Born from Pain Elementals, they swarm without mercy.

MobEntity.Name: Nightmare
MobEntity.Description: A powerful specter born from concentrated psychic torment. Its translucent form absorbs damage that would kill lesser demons.

MobEntity.Name: Bull Demon
MobEntity.Description: A hulking, horned demon that charges at full speed and gores anything in its path. Fast for its size and hard to stop.

MobEntity.Name: Pinky
MobEntity.Description: The classic pink demon of Hell. Thick-skinned and ferocious, it tears through steel with its massive jaws.

MobEntity.Name: Belphegor
MobEntity.Description: A noble demon of the infernal court. Armoured in obsidian plates and gifted with savage intelligence to match its brute strength.

MobEntity.Name: Malwrath
MobEntity.Description: The apex predator among demonkind. Ancient, scarred, and nearly unstoppable in direct combat. Very few have survived an encounter.

MobEntity.Name: Wretched
MobEntity.Description: A shrivelled, underfed cacodemon. Weaker than its kin but no less hostile, it spits erratic bolts of acidic bile.

MobEntity.Name: Cacodemon
MobEntity.Description: A massive one-eyed sphere of flesh and malice. It drifts lazily until it spots prey, then strikes with explosive plasma bolts.

MobEntity.Name: Beholder
MobEntity.Description: A larger, engorged cacodemon with multiple eyes that track independently. Each eye fires a distinct type of energy bolt.

MobEntity.Name: Rahovart
MobEntity.Description: The ancient king of cacodemons, wreathed in crackling hellfire. Its roar alone can knock a marine off their feet.

MobEntity.Name: Ghoul
MobEntity.Description: A lesser pain elemental, bloated with barely contained spiritual energy. It spits Lost Souls with frantic urgency.

MobEntity.Name: Pain Elemental
MobEntity.Description: A grotesque floating torso that perpetually births Lost Souls. Killing it without a clean kill causes a final burst of spawns.

MobEntity.Name: Fiend
MobEntity.Description: A swollen, ancient pain elemental that has feasted on countless souls. It can birth multiple Lost Souls simultaneously.

MobEntity.Name: Revenant
MobEntity.Description: A skeletal warrior risen from death, armed with a pair of shoulder-mounted guided rocket launchers. It tracks its targets with supernatural precision.

MobEntity.Name: Behemoth
MobEntity.Description: A titanic demon of incomprehensible mass. Its fists crack the floor with every step. There is no running from the Behemoth.

MobEntity.Name: Druj
MobEntity.Description: A leaner variant of the mancubus lineage. Still massively obese by human standards, but quicker and with a more accurate aim.

MobEntity.Name: Mancubus
MobEntity.Description: A grotesquely obese demon with mechanical flamethrower arms. It waddles forward spraying overlapping arcs of incendiary death.

MobEntity.Name: Infernis
MobEntity.Description: The most powerful of the mancubus bloodline, wreathed in living flame. Its projectiles leave lasting fire pools on the ground.

MobEntity.Name: Archvile
MobEntity.Description: A towering, emaciated demon that raises the dead and immolates living targets with columns of hellfire. Priority kill on sight.

MobEntity.Name: Apollyon
MobEntity.Description: The destroyer. An archvile of immense power that commands entire demonic legions. Its hellfire cannot be outrun.

MobEntity.Name: Ogre
MobEntity.Description: A brutish demonic warrior, too dumb to fear pain. It swings enormous fists and occasionally lobs a ball of green plasma.

MobEntity.Name: Hell Knight
MobEntity.Description: An elite warrior of Hell, armoured in dark chitin and lethal at both melee and range. Faster and smarter than a Baron.

MobEntity.Name: Baron
MobEntity.Description: A Baron of Hell. An ancient and powerful demonic nobleman clad in hellforged plate. Its green plasma blasts can vaporise lesser foes.

MobEntity.Name: Cyberdemon
MobEntity.Description: The ultimate fusion of demon and machine. A towering horned monstrosity with a rocket launcher grafted to its arm. The icon of Hell's military might.

MobEntity.Name: Kronos
MobEntity.Description: The devourer of worlds. An unfathomably ancient demon god whose very presence warps reality. No marine has ever returned from its domain.
